name: KiWay Harness and Cable Workbench
description: Build multi-board harness maps, drawings, bundles, splices, and BoMs.
description_full: Imports up to 50 board pin CSV documents, maps connectors by pin identity, offset, explicit maps, indexed net names, wildcard, or regex rules, supports virtual loads, and exports pin maps, net maps, wire lists, procurement BoMs, and a universal harness SVG.
